about_short_description.short_description: Building the hyperverse. We let people stream, make content, and make friends as an avatar.

product.name: Hyper Online
product.description: A mobile avatar social network and VTubing app for creating avatars, recording videos, posting content, and livestreaming to Hyper and external platforms such as Twitch, YouTube, and TikTok.

product.name: Hyper Desktop
product.description: A desktop avatar creation and streaming application for building VTuber characters, configuring scenes, and using avatars in streams, recordings, Discord calls, and video meetings.

product.name: Hyper AI
product.description: An AI character and companion product for interacting with immersive storytelling characters while keeping user conversations private from character creators.

product.name: Hyper OBS Plugin
product.description: A Windows plugin that connects Hyper avatars from an iOS device to OBS Studio for VTubing, livestreaming, recordings, and virtual-camera use in applications such as Discord and Zoom.
